gabagool22.plain_read: Mostly built both sides cheaply; profit came from sub-$1 completed pairs, not BTC prediction.
gabagool22.maker_fit: Good template for a maker bot, but only when pair cost is safely below $1.
gabagool22.engine_rule: Quote both sides only when Up bid plus Down bid is cheap, then cap one-leg inventory.

slip-me.plain_read: Built both sides, then made money by ending heavier on the winner.
slip-me.maker_fit: Useful as a signal source, but risky to copy because local overlap is overwhelmingly taker-like.
slip-me.engine_rule: Use late skew only when fair value, BTC movement, market flow, and book pressure agree.

profile_cheap_pair.label: Gabagool-style cheap pair
profile_cheap_pair.engine_rule: Quote Up and Down only when the completed pair is cheap enough.
profile_cheap_pair.risk: One-leg fills can lose if the opposite quote never fills.

profile_skew.label: Slip-me-style late skew
profile_skew.read: Higher historical PnL, but not proven maker-native.
profile_skew.engine_rule: Skew only after fair value, BTC momentum, flow, and book pressure agree.
profile_skew.risk: The source wallet appears mostly taker-like in local fills, so maker fill quality is unproven.

profile_paper_gate.label: Combined profile candidate
profile_paper_gate.read: Adds dollars but lowers quality versus skew-only.
profile_paper_gate.engine_rule: Keep cheap-pair and skew as separate paper hypotheses until live fill quality is known.
profile_paper_gate.risk: Broad pair quoting near par diluted the edge in the sweep.

decision.paper_plan: Run cheap-pair and filtered-skew paper watchers separately.
decision.do_not_live_trade_yet: Neither route has enough real maker-fill evidence.
decision.promotion_gate: Promote only after live paper fills show positive post-fill edge and low toxic-fill rate.
